name: ENGTEX
recent: Engtex 近期出现董事及大股东 Ng Hook 的股权变动，包括通过直接商业交易增持及凭单转换。公司也持续进行股份回购，并有多批凭单转换为普通股。最新季度营收 3.734 亿令吉，净利 1,200 万令吉，同比大幅增长。
notable: 集团董事经理 Tan Sri Dato' Ng Hook 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日通过直接商业交易以每股 RM0.44 增持 400 万股。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 16 日公告股份回购。
2026 年 9 月有多批凭单转换为普通股并上市，其中 9 月 11 日上市 957.6 万股。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭门期前后有买卖及转换凭单的权益变动，需留意后续持股变化。
凭单持续转换增加已发行股数，可能摊薄每股权益。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收 3.7344 亿令吉，环比增长 15.7%，同比增长 8.5%；净利 1,200.3 万令吉，环比增长 34.1%，同比增长 335.5%；净利率 3.2%，高于上季的 2.8%。

recent_en: Engtex recently saw changes in director and major shareholder Ng Hook's interests, including an acquisition via direct business transaction and warrant conversions. Latest quarter revenue was RM373.44 million with net profit of RM12.00 million, up sharply year-on-year.
notable_en: Group Managing Director Tan Sri Dato' Ng Hook acquired 4 million shares at RM0.44 each via direct business transaction on 1 Oct 2026.
Several batches of warrants were converted into ordinary shares and listed in September 2026, including 9.576 million shares listed on 11 Sep.
risks_en: Directors and major shareholders had dealings and warrant conversions around the closed period; subsequent changes in holdings should be monitored.
Ongoing warrant conversions increase the number of issued shares and may dilute per-share interests.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was RM373.44 million, up 15.7% QoQ and 8.5% YoY; net profit was RM12.003 million, up 34.1% QoQ and 335.5% YoY; net margin was 3.2% versus 2.8% in the previous quarter.
